name: MODIS MOD13Q1 Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m
description: MOD13Q1 Version 6.1 is the global 16-day composite vegetation index product generated at 250-meter spatial resolution from the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) aboard NASA's Terra satellite. Operating continuously since February 2000, MOD13Q1 delivers standardized Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) layers alongside surface reflectance bands (red, NIR, blue, MIR), view angles, and pixel-level quality assurance (QA) flags, providing the gold standard time-series for terrestrial vegetation phenology and photosynthetic activity.
